title: EnableJumping - InputEnableLayer
content:
Member of: InputEnableLayer Script Enables or disables the player's ability to jump on this layer. Syntax: Function EnableJumping(bool abEnable = true) native Parameters: - abEnable: If true, enables jumping. Otherwise disables it. Default: True Return Value: None. Examples: ; Enable jumping myLayer.EnableJumping()
; Disable jumping InputEnableLayer myLayer = InputEnableLayer.Create() myLayer.DisableJumping(false) Notes: Enabling/disabling movement will also enable/disable jumping. See Also: - InputEnableLayer Script - EnableMovement - InputEnableLayer - IsJumpingEnabled - InputEnableLayer
